description: Return the external identifiers PulseGate holds for one project, and for each one how it arrived and whether anyone has checked that it belongs. Makes no claim about whether the software is alive, maintained, or working. Look up by slug, or by an identifier you already have.

platform.description: Identifier platform to look up by, e.g. "github_repo" or "npm_package". Use with value.

slug.description: The PulseGate slug of the listing.

value.description: The identifier on that platform, e.g. owner/name for github_repo.

name: lookup_project
